Chip

Chips are compact elements that represent an input, attribute or action. They can contain icons, avatars, and close buttons, and support every contextual color.

Basic Chip

The default chip has a subtle background with a border.

React Vue Svelte
HTML
<span class="zak-chip">React</span>
<span class="zak-chip">Vue</span>
<span class="zak-chip">Svelte</span>

Color Variants

Chips support primary, success, warning, danger and info color variants.

Primary Success Warning Danger Info
HTML
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-primary">Primary</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-success">Success</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-warning">Warning</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-danger">Danger</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-info">Info</span>

Chip with Icon

Add a leading icon inside the chip for extra context.

Mail Admin Notifications
HTML
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-primary">
  <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm">...</svg>
  Mail
</span>

Chip with Avatar

Nest a small avatar inside a chip to identify a person or entity.

JA Janet Fox MK Mark Kim SR Sara Reyes
HTML
<span class="zak-chip">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-xs zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
  Janet Fox
</span>

Closable Chip

Add .zak-chip-removable and a .zak-chip-close button for removable chips. A small script removes the chip on click.

Tag: apples Tag: bananas Tag: citrus
HTML
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-removable">
  Tag: apples
  <button type="button" class="zak-chip-close" aria-label="Remove" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">&times;</button>
</span>

Chip Group

Group chips in a wrapping flex container to form a tag list.

#design #frontend #backend #docs #release
HTML
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
  <span class="zak-chip zak-chip-info">#design</span>
  <span class="zak-chip zak-chip-info">#frontend</span>
  <span class="zak-chip zak-chip-info">#backend</span>
</div>

Outlined Chip

Create an outlined chip by overriding the background with an inline style.

Outlined Primary outline Success outline Danger outline
HTML
<span class="zak-chip" style="background: transparent;">Outlined</span>
<span class="zak-chip" style="background: transparent; color: var(--zak-color-primary); border-color: var(--zak-color-primary);">Primary outline</span>
<span class="zak-chip" style="background: transparent; color: var(--zak-color-success); border-color: var(--zak-color-success);">Success outline</span>
<span class="zak-chip" style="background: transparent; color: var(--zak-color-danger); border-color: var(--zak-color-danger);">Danger outline</span>

Sizes

Scale chips with font-size — padding and icon size follow along.

Small Default Large
HTML
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-primary" style="font-size: 0.65rem;">Small</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-primary">Default</span>
<span class="zak-chip zak-chip-primary" style="font-size: 0.95rem;">Large</span>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-chipBase chip styling
.zak-chip-primaryPrimary color variant
.zak-chip-successSuccess color variant
.zak-chip-warningWarning color variant
.zak-chip-dangerDanger color variant
.zak-chip-infoInfo color variant
.zak-chip-removableAdds padding for a close button
.zak-chip-closeCircular close button inside a removable chip

Accessibility

  • Close buttons in removable chips need an accessible name, e.g. aria-label="Remove".
  • When a chip's color indicates meaning, keep the visible text readable on every variant.
  • Use aria-live="polite" on containers whose chips are dynamically added or removed.
  • Focus must move to a sensible spot after a chip is removed (e.g. the next chip or the input).
  • Chips that act as buttons or links should use the real <button> / <a> elements with visible focus styles.
